assertions.title: Click node navigates to entity detail
assertions.issues: Single-click on graph nodes does not trigger navigation to entity detail page. The click event appears to be handled but doesn't navigate.

assertions.title: Double-click node expands neighbors

steps.expected: Fetch relations, add new nodes/edges to graph
steps.observed: No network request made, node count remained at 50

assertions.issues: Double-click on graph nodes does not trigger expansion. No API request was made to fetch relations.

assertions.title: Drag node pins position

steps.expected: Node moves to new position and stays pinned
steps.observed: Node position unchanged after drag (still at 2692, 1319)

assertions.issues: Dragging nodes does not change their position. The mouse events were executed but the node remained at its original coordinates after waiting 2 seconds.

assertions.title: API error during node expansion shows inline error

steps.action: Set up network route to block **/relations requests

steps.expected: API call fails, error shown inline
steps.observed: No API call made, no error shown

assertions.issues: Cannot test error handling because the expansion feature (double-click) does not trigger any API requests in the first place (see VAL-GRAPH-005). The feature is non-functional, so error handling cannot be verified.

assertions.title: Graph to entity detail flow

evidence.network: Entity detail page accessible via direct URL

assertions.issues: Cross-flow fails because graph node click does not navigate (same issue as VAL-GRAPH-004). Entity detail page exists and works when accessed directly.

blockers.description: Graph node interactions (click, double-click, drag) are not working as expected. All three interaction types fail to trigger their intended actions.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Verified entity detail page works via direct navigation. Checked console for errors (none found). Tried multiple nodes.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 0 passed, 4 failed, 1 blocked. All graph node interactions (click, double-click, drag) are non-functional. The graph renders correctly with 50 nodes but no interactive behaviors work. Entity detail page is accessible via direct URL navigation.
